content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: AUTOMATED PAGE to @oncall-amber — Metering emitter backpressure detected. Delayed emits + duplicate replay observed, risk of overage flags. Severity P2. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/metering-emitter-backpressure

oncall-amber: ACK. I'm on. tagging @ashok for infra, @lia for telemetry, @billing-eng for customer impact.

ashok: pulling logs now. preliminary: producer lag climbing on kafka-topic `metering-emits` from 0 -> 120s over 10m. consumer lag also rising.

lia: quick telemetry snapshot:
```
metric: emitter:enqueue_time_ms
last_15m: p50=120, p95=480, p99=1200
metric: emit-retries
last_15m: +480% (compared to 1h baseline)
```

billing-eng: seeing a delta in token tallies vs shadow counts. A few customers already got automated overage emails from notif-engine. Haven't sent credits yet.

support-ops: we've paused outbound overage emails via feature-flag `billing.notify.overages` (temp). need confirmation before rolling credits.

oncall-amber: good. @support-ops confirm paused? if yes, proceed to temporary credits for affected accounts after we stabilize.

support-ops: confirmed paused. list of affected accounts queued — small batch (12), 3 are high-spend (acct: RedArc, NovaLabs, BrightK).

ashok: mitigation plan (short):
- flip emitter to fallback (kinesis-backup)
- scale consumer group + increase `max.poll.records`
- trigger emit replayer with dedupe window 2m
Commands (running now):
```bash
# switch emitter to kinesis-backup
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  https://api.redwood/configs/emit-target -d '{"target":"kinesis-backup"}'

# scale consumers
kubectl scale deployment metering-consumer --replicas=6 -n prod
```

lia: note: dedupe window must remain > max producer retry window. setting to 3m to be safe. also enabling extra logging for token-id hashing.

sre-lead: recommend also throttling internal retry loops to avoid cascading replays: set `retry_backoff_ms=1000` -> `retry_backoff_ms=5000` temporarily.

oncall-amber: running the switch now. will watch counts and heartbeat.

incident-bot: ACTION LOGGED — runbook step 3 executed by oncall-amber at 1784512358.

lia: initial metrics after failover (2m): emitter enqueue p95 down from 480ms -> 90ms, consumer lag dropping.

billing-eng: after suppression and failover, duplicate-overage flags reduced. still reconciling historic duplicates for window 00:12-00:22.

support-ops: recommending proactive credits for the three high-spend accounts to avoid chargeback. propose: credit equal to peak delta seen in their account for the window.

ashok: agreed. I've started a billing dry-run to compute deltas: `python tools/compute_delta.py --window 1784512320-1784512380 --mode dryrun`

lia: attaching sample offending log for one emit (token duplication present):
```
2026-02-14T00:15:12Z emitter INFO emit_id=abcd1234 token_count=245 status=sent retry_count=2 original_emit_ts=2026-02-14T00:14:42Z
2026-02-14T00:15:15Z replay INFO emit_id=abcd1234 token_count=245 status=sent duplicate=true
```

oncall-amber: decision: 1) keep emitter on kinesis-backup for now, 2) keep notify paused, 3) issue temporary credit to affected accounts, 4) open full postmortem and RCA.

incident-bot: NOTE: Pager handoff scheduled to daytime oncall @sre-lead at 1784516000.

sre-lead: will take handoff. action items for oncall-amber -> document exact TTLs, dedupe window, and steps to revert emit-target.

billing-eng: will prepare customer comms draft and credit amounts. need support-ops to approve before sending.

support-ops: will approve credit amounts and coordinate customer outreach.

oncall-amber: wrapping up monitoring. Metrics look stable for 10m. Opening PS with follow-ups: RCA, graceful retry throttling, improve emitter health alarms (add p95 emit latency >300ms alert), and a playbook for automated temporary crediting.

ashok: will file infra PR to add a backpressure metric and increase consumer autoscale thresholds.

lia: will push telemetry dashboard with dedupe visibility and link in postmortem.

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS -> mitigated (P2 -> monitoring). last update 1784512402.

oncall-amber: thanks all. tagging this for postmortem owners: @ashok (infra), @lia (telemetry), @billing-eng (customer impact), @support-ops (ops comms).

support-ops: noted. will follow up on outreach and scheduled reimbursements.

ashok: creating follow-up ticket: infra#8421 — add emitter backpressure metrics & auto-retry cap.

lia: creating PM#5432 for postmortem and dashboard work.

billing-eng: will post status update to #customers when credits are applied.

oncall-amber: closing thread from oncall side — monitoring continues. :white_check_mark:
